links.outcome: Nephrotoxin discontinuation within 30 hours after AKI across alert eras
links.effect: Discontinuation rose from 6 (25%) pre AKI-alert era to 14 (54%) post nephrotoxin-alert era; p = 0.047 for trend.
links.quote: Tiered implementation of CDSS for recognition of AKI and nephrotoxin exposure resulted in a progressive improvement in the discontinuation of nephrotoxins.

unlisted_practices: Tiered implementation of passive versus interruptive alerts depending on whether nephrotoxin orders are active or new

links.outcome: Discontinuation of nephrotoxic medications within 30 hours after AKI
links.effect: Discontinuation across successive eras: 6 (25%) pre AKI-alert, 8 (33%) post AKI-alert, 7 (35%) long-term follow-up, 7 (35%) pre nephrotoxin-alert, and 14 (54%) post nephrotoxin-alert (p = 0.047 for trend).
links.quote: Tiered implementation of CDSS for recognition of AKI and nephrotoxin exposure resulted in a progressive improvement in the discontinuation of nephrotoxins.

unlisted_practices: Deploying condition-specific predictive alerts in a tiered manner, progressing from passive notifications to actionable, interruptive alerts for contraindicated orders
